name: crm_lifecycle
summary: Status history, assignment audit, duplicate review, and workflow rules
description: Governance around the lead/opportunity lifecycle: an append-only status history, a full assignment audit (previous owner, new owner, assigner, method, timestamp) so reassignment never loses history, reviewed duplicate candidates matched on email/phone/company/name (never auto-merged on name alone), typed ordered assignment rules, and small reliable workflow rules with configurable intervals and recipients. crm.lead remains the authoritative record.
author: Nexa
